name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
how_to:
1. Sit upright on a flat bench, keeping feet flat and planted slightly wider than hip-width.
2. Set the barbell at shoulder height on a rack and grip it slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3. Unrack the bar and bring it to shoulder level with elbows slightly in front of the bar.
4. Engage your core and glutes to maintain balance without a backrest.
5. Press the bar overhead, extending your arms without leaning backward.
6. Lower the bar under control back to your upper chest or shoulder line.
